outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door and raises it toward the oven front (frames 94–175, image and left_ego_image). By frame 185 the door is upright against the front, and it remains closed through frame 399 (left_ego_image, corroborated by image). No failed acquisition, reopening, or unintended disturbance of nearby objects is visible.
